d:
Abhishek is back with another one of his 'not so well researched' investment idea! Ughhh!
This time, he wants to invest all his money in the US stock market, become an "international investor!" And of course, he is asking Prateek for a hike to fund this grand plan.
But, as usual he hasn't taken into account the taxation component, the limitations and the traps. Watch the episode as Prateek breaks all of this down for Abhishek and for you too!
Plus we have a US market entry strategy for you, so do watch till the end!
